decisions.reason: The positive customer response and dedicated page signal early success, so escalation makes dropping very unlikely.
With its own product page and sunk development costs, the firm is publicly committed and will persist despite no clear results yet.
Although only mentioned on the website, the product is central to the firm's waste-processing portfolio and recently launched, so early disappointments are attributed to temporary causes.
As a stationary shredder in the core business, sunk investments and responsibility for the launch lead management to keep it.
Its narrower green-waste focus raises some uncertainty, but the firm has committed resources and will likely persist rather than drop it.
The dedicated product page signals high public commitment, making early withdrawal improbable under escalation of commitment.
